concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-manage-liable-accounts]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace-owned main, incorrect-split and compensation liable-account roles, including failed-destination fallback and conditional negative-balance remedy timing.
warnings: Incorrect split destination fallback books funds to the marketplace reserved incorrect splits account when the target is missing, closed/suspended, or lacks receive capability (raw lines 31–37); this is not receipt by the intended user.

Reserved compensation debit follows a negative balance lasting more than 30 days and occurs on the first day of the following month (raw line 43); the reserved account itself can become negative (raw line 45).
